comment: Seconds one package's tests took in the CI run of noema#482 (go test -race inside a three-way shard, 12 Nov 2026), used only to balance the core test shards. platform/db alone took 107 s and bounds any shard that holds it; the others are the figures of the same run, except record/chain, execution/e2e and record/verify, which keep the figures of the noema#221 run of 11 Nov (they were not in the logs read). A package that is not listed counts 2 seconds. A stale weight changes the balance, never the coverage: every package is always in exactly one shard.
